parameters.query: INSERT INTO grownic.knowledge(id,title,question,answer,source_url,approved,expires_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,true,$6::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET title=excluded.title,question=excluded.question,answer=excluded.answer,source_url=excluded.source_url,approved=true,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,updated_at=now() RETURNING id;
